visual_synopsis: Appears to be a compilation of several unrelated segments: a man in white golf clothes practising on a driving range and course (with a brief black-and-white insert of him being handed a trophy in a shop), then a casino sequence with a roulette table, a female croupier and stacks of cash, then a man in a beige suit alone and agitated in a bright apartment (with a cutaway close-up of a frog), and finally a packed courtroom where a young man in a dark suit speaks at a microphone in front of a robed judge and the Armenian flag. The four blocks have different casts and no visible connection to each other.
